general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture, Discussions, Group work, Practice, Seminar, Laboratory work,Tutorials,
general_information.Description: This course covers general guidelines to creating effective data visualizations, practices to consider best category of graph that meet audience needs. Guide to explore data and how it might be visualized. Show the most common and exible graphs, building a data visualization style guide and how to pull together in a series of visual model.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend more than 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. 7. Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submlit to the teacher 01 day after the course.

description: This course covers general guidelines to creating effective data visualizations, practices to consider best category of graph that meet audience needs.
